story.x: Why should your yard adapt to your mower?
story.z: 为什么您的庭院要适应您的割草机？

story.x: ARANIX adapts to your yard—the challenging conditions other robotic mowers often struggle with.
story.z: ARANIX 可适应您的庭院——其他割草机器人往往难以应对的严苛条件。

story.x: From steep slopes and uneven ground to tight turns and complex layouts, it gives you complete confidence to let it mow—without spending time rescuing, trimming, or mowing what your robot leaves behind.
story.z: 从陡峭的斜坡和不平坦的地面，到急转弯和复杂的布局，它都能让您完全放心让它去割草——无需花时间去补救、修剪或割掉机器人遗漏的草。

story.x: Because real lawns deserve a mower designed for real conditions.
story.z: 因为真正的草坪需要一款专为实际情况设计的割草机。

story.x: Each wheel is independently driven and steered. The Motion AI Agent combines perception of obstacles, terrain, slopes and available space with real-time analysis of resistance and traction at each wheel. It then coordinates the drive and steering of all four wheels to select and execute the most suitable maneuver, including zero-radius turns, diagonal movement, crab-style lateral movement and multi-step self-recovery.
story.z: 每个车轮均独立驱动和转向。运动人工智能代理将对障碍物、地形、坡度和可用空间的感知与对每个车轮的阻力和牵引力的实时分析相结合。然后，它协调所有四个车轮的驱动和转向，以选择并执行最合适的操纵动作，包括零半径转弯、对角线移动、螃蟹式横向移动和多步自恢复。

story.x: ARANIX performs true 0-radius turns without needing extra turning space. It moves effortlessly through narrow passages, tight corners, and complex lawn layouts, delivering smooth, uninterrupted mowing with fewer missed spots.
story.z: ARANIX能够实现真正的零半径转弯，无需额外的转弯空间。它能轻松穿过狭窄通道、拐角处和布局复杂的草坪，实现平稳、不间断的割草，漏割的区域更少。

story.x: Powered by AI, ARANIX intelligently switches between crab-walk and diagonal movement to maneuver in multiple directions. Compared with conventional steering, its omnidirectional mobility delivers smoother turns, faster recovery, and uninterrupted mowing across complex terrain.
story.z: ARANIX 由人工智能驱动，可在螃蟹式行走和对角线行走之间智能切换，从而实现多方向的操控。与传统转向相比，其全向移动性可实现更平稳的转弯、更快的恢复以及在复杂地形上的不间断割草。

story.x: Unlike conventional mowers that drag, crush, or scuff the lawn, ARANIX minimizes turf scuffing, grass flattening, and unnecessary pressure on the lawn, helping protect healthy growth while keeping your yard looking its best.
story.z: 与拖拽、碾压或磨损草坪的传统割草机不同，ARANIX最大限度地减少了草坪的磨损、草的压扁和对草坪的不必要压力，有助于保护草坪的健康生长，同时让您的庭院保持最佳外观。

story.x: With its omnidirectional mobility, ARANIX reaches deep into corners and along complex lawn edges with ease. It maximizes mowing coverage, reducing the need for manual touch-ups after mowing.
story.z: 凭借全向移动能力，ARANIX可以轻松深入角落，并沿着复杂的草坪边缘行驶。它最大限度地扩大了割草覆盖范围，减少了割草后人工修剪的需要。

story.x: ARANIX confidently climbs, turns, and moves laterally on slopes up to 40° (85%), maintaining outstanding stability and control for smooth, reliable mowing across challenging terrain.
story.z: ARANIX能够自信地在坡度高达40°（85%）的斜坡上攀爬、转向和横向移动，保持出色的稳定性和操控性，从而在崎岖地形上实现平稳可靠的割草。

story.x: Each wheel adapts independently to uneven terrain, helping maintain continuous ground contact over roots, ruts, and bumps. By keeping the cutting deck stable, ARANIX delivers a cleaner, more consistent cut even across challenging lawns.
story.z: 每个车轮都能独立适应不平坦的地形，有助于在树根、车辙和颠簸处保持持续的地面接触。通过保持割草盘的稳定性，ARANIX即使在崎岖不平的草坪上也能实现更干净、更均匀的割草效果。

story.x: Easily climbs over roots, uneven ground, and overcomes obstacles up to 70mm (2.8 in) to maintain continuous, efficient mowing where other mowers struggle.
story.z: 轻松越过树根、不平地面，并克服高达70毫米（2.8英寸）的障碍物，在其他割草机难以胜任的地方保持持续、高效的割草。

story.x: Cut. Mulch. Nourish. All in one pass.
story.z: 割草。覆盖。滋养。一次完成。

story.x: Before every cut, FlowCut 2.0 uses powerful airflow lifts bent and flattened grass upright for improved blade contact. The result is a cleaner, more even cut with less tearing, helping keep your lawn healthier and better looking.
story.z: 在每次割草之前，FlowCut 2.0都会利用强劲的气流将弯曲和压扁的草抬起并立起，以改善刀片的接触。这样一来，割草效果更干净、更均匀，撕裂更少，有助于保持草坪的健康和美观。

story.x: 18 staggered blades work with dual-layer cutting discs and integrated airflow to recut clippings into millimeter-sized pieces. Finer mulch breaks down faster, returning nutrients naturally to your lawn.
story.z: 18片交错排列的刀片与双层切割盘和集成气流配合工作，将剪下的草屑再次切割成毫米大小的碎屑。更细的碎草分解得更快，将营养物质自然地归还给您的草坪。

story.x: Counter-rotating cutting discs and optimized airflow distribute fine grass clippings evenly across your lawn. With fewer clumps and less buildup beneath the deck, your lawn stays naturally nourished—no collection required.
story.z: 反向旋转的切割盘和优化的气流将细碎的草屑均匀地撒在草坪上。由于割草机机罩下方积聚的草屑更少、结块更少，您的草坪将得到天然滋养，无需收集草屑。

story.x: Handles tall, wet and tough grass with ease.
story.z: 轻松应对高大、潮湿和坚韧的草。

story.x: Switch between pivoting razor blade discs for everyday mowing and straight blade discs for more demanding mowing conditions. Adjust the cutting height from 25 to 95 mm to suit different grass types and seasonal growth, giving you greater flexibility for a consistently well-maintained lawn.
story.z: 在用于日常割草的旋转式刀片盘和用于更苛刻割草条件的直刀盘之间切换。将割草高度从25毫米调整到95毫米，以适应不同草种和季节性生长，为您提供更大的灵活性，让草坪始终保持良好状态。

story.x: Dual high-output cutting motors maintain consistent blade speed through thick, dense, and demanding grass conditions. With powerful, reliable cutting performance, ARANIX delivers cleaner results while reducing slowdowns during every mow.
story.z: 双高功率切割电机可在草丛茂密、密集和具有挑战性的条件下保持刀片速度恒定。ARANIX具备强大而可靠的切割性能，在每次割草过程中都能提供更干净的作业效果，同时减少速度减慢的情况。

story.x: Wider coverage. Faster mowing. Fewer missed spots.
story.z: 覆盖范围更广。割草速度更快。漏割的区域更少。

story.x: The standard cutting deck mows within 3 cm of the lawn edge, while the dedicated edging module trims right up to the edge for true 0 cm edge cutting. Fewer uncut strips mean less manual trimming and a cleaner-looking lawn.
story.z: 标准割草盘可在距草坪边缘3厘米的范围内割草，而专用修边模块则可修剪至边缘，实现真正的0厘米边缘修剪。未割草带更少，意味着需要进行的人工修剪更少，草坪外观也更整洁。

story.x: Multimodal AI fuses data from 360° LiDAR, 300° Vision SLAM and nRTK to understand the yard in real time, enabling centimeter-level navigation without relying on a single signal source.
story.z: 多模态人工智能融合了来自360°激光雷达、300°视觉SLAM和nRTK的数据，实时了解场地情况，从而实现厘米级导航，而无需依赖单一信号源。

story.x: With repeat positioning accuracy of up to ±2 cm, ARANIX follows planned mowing paths with exceptional precision. Accurate path tracking helps reduce missed areas while maintaining a clean, consistent finish.
story.z: ARANIX的重复定位精度高达±2厘米，能够以出色的精度遵循规划的割草路径。精确的路径跟踪有助于减少漏割区域，同时保持整洁一致的修剪效果。

story.x: *nRTK is available on ARANIX 4000 and ARANIX 6000 only. Specifications vary by model and region.
story.z: *nRTK 仅在 ARANIX 4000 和 ARANIX 6000 上可用。规格因型号和地区而异。

story.x: No complicated antenna installation is required to get started. Auto mapping makes setup quick and intuitive, while optional nRTK is available whenever higher positioning precision is needed.
story.z: 无需进行复杂的天线安装即可开始使用。自动测绘使设置快速直观，而在需要更高定位精度时，可选择使用 nRTK。

story.x: Even if RTK signals are temporarily unavailable, ARANIX can continue mowing areas of up to 2,000㎡ using its onboard perception system. No constant RTK, Wi-Fi, or 4G connection is required for reliable, uninterrupted mowing.
story.z: 即使RTK信号暂时不可用，ARANIX仍可利用其车载感知系统继续在面积达2000平方米的区域内进行割草作业。无需持续的RTK、Wi-Fi或4G连接，即可实现可靠、不间断的割草。

story.x: Keyboards make you choose. A big battery means a thick case. Speed means charging every few days. Lights mean a higher price. You pick one and give up the other.
story.z: 键盘让您不得不做出选择。大电池意味着厚机身。速度意味着每隔几天就要充电。灯光意味着更高的价格。您只能二选一。

story.x: We spent two years refusing to pick. V2 carries 10,000 mAh and still sits 17.4 mm low at the front. It reports 8,000 times a second when you want speed, and runs up to 1,000 hours when you would rather forget the cable. Every key lights up, and the price still starts at $99.
story.z: 我们花了两年时间，拒绝做出选择。V2 搭载 10000 mAh 电池，前部仍仅有 17.4 毫米厚。当您需要速度时，它每秒可报告 8,000 次；当您不想使用充电线时，它最长可运行 1,000 小时。每个按键都会亮起，起售价仍为 99 美元。

story.x: Big battery and low front. Fast and long-lived. Bright and $99. All of it, at once.
story.z: 大电池，低前置。快速且持久。明亮，仅售99美元。所有优点，一应俱全。

story.x: First the sound. Two switch housings: Thock, deep and round; Clack, bright and short. Pick one, or both if you want.
story.z: 首先是声音。两种轴体外壳：Thock，声音低沉圆润；Clack，声音清脆短促。选择一种，或者如果您愿意，也可以两种都选。

story.x: Then the feel. Three gasket mounts, soft, even and firm, that swap without tools.
story.z: 然后是手感。三个垫片支架，柔软、均匀且稳固，无需工具即可更换。

story.x: Under all of it, foams, rebuilt: six layers instead of five, so what reaches your ear is the key and nothing else. You will do this for years. Every keystroke should be one you look forward to.
story.z: 在所有这些之下，是经过重新设计的泡沫：由五层变为六层，因此传到您耳朵里的只有琴键的声音，别无其他。您将使用它很多年。每一次敲击键盘都应该让您充满期待。

story.x: Hear the sound test:
story.z: 听到声音

story.x: 256 keyboards in one case.
story.z: 一个包装箱中有256个键盘。

story.x: Three gasket mounts, six foam layers, two switches. That is 256 ways to build one keyboard, or 512 if you own both switches. One press opens the case, every switch is hot-swap, and nothing needs solder or a screwdriver. Finding your sound takes minutes, not a weekend.
story.z: 三个垫片支架、六层泡棉、两个开关。这意味着有 256 种方式可以组装一个键盘，如果您同时拥有两种开关，则有 512 种方式。一按即可打开外壳，每个轴体均可热插拔，无需焊接或使用螺丝刀。找到您的专属声音只需几分钟，而不是一个周末。

story.x: Three gasket mounts. Swap them by hand.
story.z: 三个垫片支架。用手更换。

story.x: One press and the case is open. No screws, no tools.
story.z: 一按即可打开保护壳。无需螺丝，无需工具。

story.x: Flipper One runs on completely open-source Linux firmware with a mainline kernel. This means full compatibility with the latest kernel versions:
story.z: Flipper One 运行在完全开源的 Linux 固件上，采用主线内核。这意味着与最新内核版本完全兼容：

story.x: *   Mainline Linux kernel support — full support in upstream Linux kernel.
story.z: * 主线 Linux 内核支持 — 在上游 Linux 内核中提供全面支持。

story.x: *   No binary blobs — no proprietary code or binaries in the boot process.
story.z: * 无二进制大对象 — 启动过程中没有专有代码或二进制文件。

story.x: *   No vendor-locked BSP — free from outdated vendor board support packages.
story.z: * 无供应商锁定 BSP — 无需使用过时的供应商板级支持包。

story.x: Our goal is to create a fully upstream-supported ARM computer that never becomes outdated, along with a well-documented platform giving the community maximum freedom to customize. To pull this off, we've [partnered with the Collabora team](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html), well-known contributors to the Linux kernel.
story.z: 我们的目标是打造一款完全由上游支持的 ARM 电脑，使其永远不会过时，同时提供一个文档齐全的平台，让社区享有最大的定制自由。为了实现这一目标，我们[与 Collabora 团队](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html)建立了合作关系，该团队是 Linux 内核的知名贡献者。

story.x: *   Layer 0 (Zero) — Offline point-to-point access-control protocols: NFC, low-frequency RFID, Sub-1 GHz radio, Infrared, wired protocols like iButton, UART, SPI, I2C. Based on a low-power microcontroller.
story.z: *第0（零）层 — 离线点对点访问控制协议：NFC、低频RFID、Sub-1 GHz无线电、红外、有线协议（如iButton、UART、SPI、I2C）。基于低功耗微控制器。

story.x: *   Layer 1 (One) — Everything that's IP-connected: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 5G, and satellite. It's all about networking, data transfer, and high-performance computing. An open Linux toolkit running on powerful hardware, enough computing power to handle SDR and local AI.
story.z: *第1层（一层）——所有通过IP连接的设备：Wi-Fi、以太网、5G和卫星。这完全与联网、数据传输和高性能计算有关。一个在强大硬件上运行的开放式Linux工具包，具有足够的计算能力来处理SDR和本地AI。

story.x: So they're not "newer" and "older" generations of the same product. Flipper One doesn't replace Flipper Zero — they're different categories of devices. Comparing them directly would be like comparing a hammer to a screwdriver.
story.z: 因此，它们并不是同一款产品的“更新”和“更旧”的代际产品。Flipper One 并不取代 Flipper Zero，它们属于不同的设备类别。直接比较它们就像拿锤子和螺丝刀作比较。

story.x: *   Low-power MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — manages LCD display, buttons, power and controls system boot stages.
story.z: * 低功耗 MCU（Raspberry Pi RP2350）——管理液晶屏、按钮、电源并控制系统启动阶段。

story.x: *   High-performance CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — runs Linux kernel and user apps, and manages high-speed peripheral interfaces: Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PCIe, USB, HDMI, etc.
story.z: * 高性能 CPU（Rockchip RK3576）——运行 Linux 内核和用户应用程序，并管理高速外围接口：以太网、Wi-Fi、PCIe、USB、HDMI 等。

story.x: The idea behind the [2-processor architecture](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) is to make Flipper One a fully standalone device that remains operational even if the user completely breaks the Linux system. It allows to recover OS without needing an external computer or additional software.
story.z: [双处理器架构](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture)背后的理念是，让Flipper One成为一款完全独立的设备，即使用户彻底破坏了Linux系统，它仍能保持正常运行。它允许在不需要外部计算机或额外软件的情况下恢复操作系统。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to a laptop with a single USB-C cable to get SSH console access and charge the device at the same time. No extra adapters are needed for Linux console access or power — Flipper One can simultaneously emulate a USB network adapter, a serial (COM port), or disk device.![Image 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)
story.z: 使用一根USB-C线缆将Flipper One连接到笔记本电脑，即可获得SSH控制台访问权限，并同时为设备充电。访问Linux控制台或供电无需额外的适配器——Flipper One可以同时模拟USB网络适配器、串行（COM端口）或磁盘设备！[图片 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)

story.x: *   Power IN/OUT — the USB-C1 port supports 5–20 V Power Delivery and can charge Flipper One or power your laptop.
story.z: * 电源输入/输出 — USB-C1 端口支持 5–20 V 电源传输，可为 Flipper One 充电或为您的笔记本电脑供电。

story.x: *   Device Emulation — the same port also emulates a USB network adapter, serial device, or disk drive. All at speeds of up to 5 Gbps.
story.z: * 设备仿真 — 同一个端口还可以仿真 USB 网络适配器、串行设备或磁盘驱动器。所有速度均高达 5 Gbps。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to an external display using a single USB Type-C cable and get a full desktop experience. ![Image 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)
story.z: 使用一根 USB Type-C 线缆将 Flipper One 连接到外接显示器，即可获得完整的桌面体验。！[图片 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)

story.x: *   USB DisplayPort Alt Mode — video output at 4K@120Hz to an external display over a single USB-C cable.
story.z: * USB DisplayPort Alt 模式 — 通过单根 USB-C 线缆以 4K@120Hz 的分辨率将视频输出到外接显示器。

story.x: *   USB Host + Charging — connect peripherals such as a keyboard and mouse through your monitor’s USB hub while charging Flipper One over the same cable.
story.z: * USB主机 + 充电 — 通过显示器的USB集线器连接键盘和鼠标等外围设备，同时通过同一根线缆为Flipper One充电。

story.x: We wanted to make alternative firmware development for Flipper One easier. You can debug and perform a full system recovery through the same primary USB-C port (USB-C1). For most development tasks, you won't need a separate debugger.
story.z: 我们希望让Flipper One的替代固件开发变得更加容易。您可以通过同一个主USB-C端口（USB-C1）进行调试和执行完整系统恢复。对于大多数开发任务，您不需要单独的调试器。

story.x: Using the USB-C1 port, you can access the debug console & BOOTSEL mode for recovering the RP2350 MCU, and MaskROM mode for recovering the RK3576 CPU.
story.z: 使用 USB-C1 端口，您可以访问调试控制台和 BOOTSEL 模式以恢复 RP2350 MCU，以及 MaskROM 模式以恢复 RK3576 CPU。

story.x: *   2× Gigabit Ethernet— two independent WAN/LAN ports, each running at 1 Gbps. Can be used for a transparent bridge, MitM sniffing, and more.
story.z: * 2 个千兆以太网端口：两个独立的 WAN/LAN 端口，每个端口的运行速度均为 1 Gbps。可用于透明网桥、中间人攻击嗅探等。

story.x: *   Wi-Fi 6E— based on the MT7921AUN chipset with monitor mode support. Covers 2.4/5/6 GHz bands and can run as both a Wi-Fi Client (STA) and a Hotspot (AP).
story.z: * Wi-Fi 6E— 基于 MT7921AUN 芯片组，支持监视模式。覆盖 2.4/5/6 GHz 频段，既可以作为 Wi-Fi 客户端 (STA) 运行，也可以作为热点 (AP) 运行。

story.x: *   Cellular modem— 5G or LTE modem via the M.2 expansion module, with support for external antennas. Accepts a physical Nano SIM (4FF) and eSIM.
story.z: * 蜂窝调制解调器— 通过 M.2 扩展模块实现的 5G 或 LTE 调制解调器，支持外置天线。支持物理 Nano SIM 卡 (4FF) 和 eSIM 卡。

story.x: *   USB Ethernet— up to 5 Gbps emulated over USB-C. Connect your laptop or smartphone via a USB cable to add an extra network interface. Works via USB CDC-NCM, so no drivers are required.
story.z: * USB 以太网——通过 USB-C 模拟，速度高达 5 Gbps。通过 USB 线缆连接笔记本电脑或智能手机，即可添加额外的网络接口。通过 USB CDC-NCM 工作，因此无需驱动程序。

story.x: Out of the box, Flipper One can work as a gateway to any network, a multi-hotspot bridge, an inline Ethernet sniffer, a USB Wi-Fi/Ethernet adapter for a PC or phone.
story.z: Flipper One 开箱即用，可充当任何网络的网关、多热点桥接器、串联式以太网嗅探器、用于电脑或手机的 USB Wi-Fi/以太网适配器。

story.x: Analyze wired and wireless IP networks: discover active hosts, scan for open ports and services, detect network attacks and report anomalies. Flipper One comes with built-in apps for network analysis, mapping network topology, and detecting host misconfigurations.![Image 13](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/901/978/c2894be981d98c00ee8d0a063b05ceb1_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794772894&width=1360&sig=b8%2BQACZj70PNfVrKKT0uzYmMNTfFCY8OEM1kvDS5CGM%3D)It can also identify vulnerable and outdated services, act as a honeypot to detect network scanning activity, and save the results as exportable reports.

story.x: A shockingly thin, fully mechanical keyboard. Altar II combines a superlative typing experience with an unbelievable design.
story.z: 超薄的全机械键盘。 Altar II 结合了最高级的打字体验和令人难以置信的设计。

story.x: The designer of Altar II discusses some of the design goals, background and difficulties of making Altar II a reality.
story.z: 《Altar II》的设计师讨论了一些设计目标、​​背景以及使《Altar II》成为现实的困难。

story.x: A brief overview of some Altar II functionality. Here it is shown pairing over Bluetooth and working with Sanctuary™, its native macOS companion app. We demonstrate using M-Dial™, remapping keys, and more, and give a general tour of the app. Shown on engineering prototype hardware with pre-alpha software and firmware.
story.z: Altar II 部分功能的简要概述。此处显示它通过蓝牙配对并与其本机 macOS 配套应用程序 Sanctuary™ 配合使用。我们演示如何使用 M-Dial™、重新映射按键等，并对该应用程序进行总体介绍。显示在带有 pre-alpha 软件和固件的工程原型硬件上。

story.x: The strikingly slim profile is enabled by breakthrough mechanical switch design — a dual steel-armed switch with a laterally arranged spring and 40gf actuation force.
story.z: 突破性的机械开关设计实现了惊人的纤薄外形——双钢臂开关，带有横向排列的弹簧和 40gf 的驱动力。

story.x: At 4.75mm, Altar II is the thinnest production mechanical keyboard ever made.
story.z: Altar II 厚度为 4.75 毫米，是有史以来最薄的量产机械键盘。

story.x: A magnetically detachable, clickable, swappable dial for volume, media and other controls. Two sizes of M-Dial™ are included in the box: Standard issue and low-profile.
story.z: 可磁性拆卸、可点击、可更换的音量、媒体和其他控制旋钮。包装盒中包含两种尺寸的 M-Dial™：标准型和低调型。

story.x: A haptic driver called Harmonic Synthesiser™ adds subtle physical feedback to typing, dial rotation, and keyboard state changes.
story.z: 称为 Harmonic Synthesiser™ 的触觉驱动器为打字、拨号盘旋转和键盘状态变化添加了微妙的物理反馈。

story.x: A fully native, Swift-based companion app for macOS gives full control over key mapping, backlight, haptics, audio and M-Dial™ functionality. Its lickable UI feels right at home on Mac.
story.z: 一款完全原生、基于 Swift 的 macOS 配套应用程序可以完全控制按键映射、背光、触觉、音频和 M-Dial™ 功能。其可爱的用户界面在 Mac 上给人一种宾至如归的感觉。

story.x: NiteLite™ is a red backlight that preserves night vision, and reduces eye strain by avoiding the blue light used in most keyboard backlights.
story.z: NiteLite™ 是一种红色背光灯，可保持夜视能力，并通过避免大多数键盘背光灯中使用的蓝光来减轻眼睛疲劳。

story.x: A two-layer Inertial Damper™ system isolates the typing platform and gives Altar II a unique typing sound and feel.
story.z: 两层 Inertial Damper™ 系统隔离打字平台，并为 Altar II 带来独特的打字声音和感觉。

story.x: Every element of Altar II — key shape, layout, typography, materials, footprint — is painstakingly designed, down to the last detail.
story.z: 《Altar II》的每一个元素——关键形状、布局、排版、材料、占地面积——都经过精心设计，直至最后一个细节。

story.x: Altar II's slimline chassis keeps wrists almost flat during typing, reducing the strain associated with most keyboards, and negating the need for angling the typing platform.
story.z: Altar II 的纤薄底盘使手腕在打字时几乎保持平坦，减少了大多数键盘带来的压力，并且无需调整打字平台的角度。

story.x: Fitting a full mechanical keyboard, battery, haptic system, speaker, and wireless radio into a sub-5mm chassis required bleeding-edge engineering and effort.
story.z: 将全机械键盘、电池、触觉系统、扬声器和无线电装置安装到 5 毫米以下的底盘中需要尖端的工程技术和努力。

story.x: Altar II is made from recycled plastic and recyclable aluminium, and ships in completely plastic-free packaging.
story.z: Altar II 由回收塑料和可回收铝制成，并采用完全不含塑料的包装运输。

story.x: Up to 30 days of typical use on a single charge, with two days of usage from two minutes of charging over USB-C.
story.z: 一次充电典型使用时间长达 30 天，通过 USB-C 充电两分钟即可使用两天。

story.x: Altar II keyboard, coiled USB-C cable, two M-Dials (standard issue and low profile), field manual, and EMO stickers.
story.z: Altar II 键盘、USB-C 盘绕线、两个 M-Dial（标准版和低调版）、现场手册和 EMO 贴纸。

story.z: 按住 Cue 并说出消息及其收件人。邮件已发送，您的手机仍留在原处。在车里，Cue 位于仪表板上，带有安装附件。

story.x: A Flic Hub is a small box that plugs in at home. It runs the Cue app over Wi-Fi, so every Cue in the house keeps working when your phone is in another room, out of battery or out the door. Several bundles come with one, and you can add one to any reward. You don't need one to get started.
story.z: Flic Hub 是一个可以在家中插入的小盒子。它通过 Wi-Fi 运行 Cue 应用程序，因此当您的手机在另一个房间、没电池或出门在外时，家里的每个 Cue 都能继续工作。多个捆绑包附带一个，您可以将一个添加到任何奖励中。您不需要一个就可以开始。

story.x: That's us: Shortcut Labs in Stockholm, Sweden, the people who made every Flic. Press quotes are about earlier Flic products.
story.z: 这就是我们：瑞典斯德哥尔摩的 Shortcut Labs，每一款 Flic 的制作者。媒体引述是关于早期 Flic 产品的。

story.x: The Cue app is the first responder. It handles everyday things on its own, for free, and hands bigger jobs to the agents and tools you connect.
story.z: Cue 应用程序是第一响应者。它可以免费自行处理日常事务，并将更大的工作交给您连接的代理和工具。

story.x: Most of what you say needs no answer: a short beep tells you it landed. For a bigger question you don't sit and wait. Ask now, put Cue away, and two beeps tell you when the answer is ready.
story.z: 您所说的大部分内容无需回答：一声短促的蜂鸣声告诉您飞机已着陆。对于更大的问题，你不能坐下来等待。现在就问，把 Cue 收起来，当答案准备好时，会发出两声蜂鸣声告诉您。

story.x: It comes back in three ways, and you can also have it sent on as a text message, an email or a note in apps like Notion.
story.z: 它以三种方式返回，您还可以将其作为短信、电子邮件或 Notion 等应用程序中的便笺发送。

story.x: Cue waits on its magnetic wall plate at home. Lift it off and clip it on when you leave. The clip and the wall mount are add-ons, and most homes want more than one Cue: one on you, one by the door, one in the kitchen.
story.z: Cue 在家里的磁性壁板上等待。离开时将其取下并夹上。夹子和壁挂支架都是附加组件，大多数家庭都需要不止一个 Cue：一个在您身上，一个在门边，一个在厨房。

story.x: Bigger jobs, in seconds: the kind that usually take an evening of open tabs. Say it to Cue, and your AI agent, for example Grok Bot, researches, gathers and sums up the best options with pros and cons.
story.z: 更大的工作，在几秒钟内完成：通常需要一晚上打开标签的工作。对 Cue 说，你的人工智能代理（例如 Grok Bot）会研究、收集并总结最佳选项的优缺点。

story.x: Connect your own account in the Cue app, and Flic's cloud hands over what you say, cloud to cloud. More agents are coming.
story.z: 在 Cue 应用程序中连接您自己的帐户，Flic 的云就会将您所说的内容从云传输到云。更多代理即将到来。

story.x: Start a long task, walk away and know when to come back.
story.z: 开始一项长期任务，走开并知道何时回来。

story.x: Cue works with the email, calendar and notes you already keep in the cloud, and you pick the destinations in the Cue app. Everything you say shows up there, with where it went. When Cue isn't sure, it asks. It learns from every correction.
story.z: Cue 可与您已保存在云端的电子邮件、日历和笔记配合使用，并且您可以在 Cue 应用程序中选择目的地。你所说的一切都会显示在那里，以及它去了哪里。当 Cue 不确定时，它会询问。它从每次纠正中学习。

story.x: Your hand does the routing, so your voice only has to carry the content. Push, double push and hold on two buttons, swipe four ways, turn and shake, and choose in the Cue app what each one does.
story.z: 您的手负责路由，因此您的声音只需携带内容。按下、双击并按住两个按钮、向四种方向滑动、转动和摇动，然后在 Cue 应用程序中选择每个按钮的功能。

story.x: Oskar, our CTO, with a working prototype at his desk. The desktop features in the video are still experiments and can change.
story.z: 我们的首席技术官奥斯卡 (Oskar) 的办公桌上摆着一个工作原型。视频中的桌面功能仍处于实验阶段，可能会发生变化。

story.x: Pick the agent session by turning Cue, give the next instruction by voice and let the agent get on with it, as in the video above. Cue already drives Claude, Codex and Gemini sessions on your computer.
story.z: 通过转动 Cue 选择代理会话，通过语音给出下一个指令，然后让代理继续执行，如上面的视频所示。 Cue 已在您的计算机上驱动 Claude、Codex 和 Gemini 会话。

story.x: Push to start a presentation, and talk to add a note without leaving the stage.
story.z: 按下即可开始演示，无需离开讲台即可通过语音添加注释。

story.x: For the first time, Flic Cue and the Flic buttons you already have connect to Home Assistant, and Cue runs it by voice. It was the integration our waitlist asked for most.
story.z: 这是第一次，Flic Cue 和您已有的 Flic 按钮连接到 Home Assistant，Cue 通过语音运行它。这是我们候补名单上最需要的整合。

story.x: Every Flic Cue can be configured and built into your own apps, agents and systems. Build the thing you wish existed, and share it with the community.
story.z: 每个 Flic Cue 都可以配置并内置到您自己的应用程序、代理和系统中。构建您希望存在的东西，并与社区分享。

story.x: The landscape moves fast. New ways to plug into AI agents appear all the time, and some get shut down. We aim for integrations that work on the lowest tiers possible, though they still need an active subscription with each service.
story.z: 风景移动得很快。插入人工智能代理的新方法一直在出现，但有些却被关闭了。我们的目标是尽可能在最低层上进行集成，尽管它们仍然需要对每项服务进行有效订阅。

story.x: We'll keep adding support for the next big thing, and with help from the community, the small things too. What works today might not be possible tomorrow. What we can promise is to do everything in our power to make Flic Cue the most versatile voice button on the planet.
story.z: 我们将继续增加对下一件大事的支持，并在社区的帮助下，为小事提供支持。今天有效的方法明天可能就行不通了。我们可以承诺的是，尽我们所能，使 Flic Cue 成为地球上最通用的语音按钮。

story.x: Add-ons ship in the same box as your reward, at no extra shipping cost.
story.z: 附加组件与您的奖励在同一个盒子中发货，无需额外运费。

story.x: *   Keep your watch and style. No more bands, rings or other wearables.
story.z: * 保持你的手表和风格。不再有手环、戒指或其他可穿戴设备。

story.x: *   HIYD is tiny. Only 2.7mm thin and 25mm across
story.z: * HIYD 很小。厚度仅 2.7 毫米，宽度仅 25 毫米

story.x: *   Data privacy. Your data is yours. Now and forever.
story.z: * 数据隐私。您的数据是您的。现在和永远。

story.x: *   No subscription. Free for life for all Kickstarter backers.
story.z: * 无需订阅。所有 Kickstarter 支持者终身免费。

story.x: *   Battery life up to 20 days. With additional BatteryBand. 4 days without.

story.x: *   Fits 95% of watches and straps. From "NATO Style" straps to women's sizes.
story.z: * 适合 95% 的手表和表带。从“北约风格”肩带到女士尺码。

story.x: *   Kickstarter discount. Pledge now for launch pricing before we hit retail!
story.z: * Kickstarter 折扣。现在就在我们开始零售之前承诺发布价格！

story.x: *   FREE Soft Band. Choose your color, FREE with every HIYD bought on Kickstarter.
story.z: * 免费软带。在 Kickstarter 上购买的每件 HIYD 均可免费选择您的颜色。

story.x: Your special VIP reservation price and gift (additional Soft Band) is waiting for you Check your email for the link.Thanks again ❤️
story.z: 您的特别 VIP 预订价格和礼物（额外软带）正在等您查看您的电子邮件中的链接。再次感谢❤️

story.x: Smartwatches ask you to trade all that for a screen and distractions. Plenty of us tried. Most of us went back to the watches we love.
story.z: 智能手表要求你用所有这些来换取屏幕和干扰。我们很多人都尝试过。我们大多数人都回到了我们喜爱的手表上。

story.x: Smart rings and fitness bands aren't much better. A band means wearing something on your other wrist. A ring can feel bulky and strange. Neither was designed around your style. And many people, us included, simply find them uncomfortable and ugly.
story.z: 智能戒指和健身手环也好不了多少。腕带意味着在另一只手腕上佩戴一些东西。戒指给人的感觉是笨重且奇怪。两者都不是根据您的风格设计的。许多人，包括我们，只是觉得它们不舒服而且丑陋。

story.x: So you're left with a choice: The watch you love, or knowing how you sleep, recover and perform...
story.z: 因此，您面临的选择是：您喜爱的手表，或者了解您的睡眠、恢复和表现情况......

story.x: We're a team of ex Apple, Tesla and YC engineers who love watches ourselves.
story.z: 我们是一支由前 Apple、Tesla 和 YC 工程师组成的团队，他们自己也热爱手表。

story.x: We didn't think anyone should have to make that choice. So we built something that doesn't ask you to: HIYD. Earlier this year, we put our field prototype (which we called our Gen 1) into the hands of real customers and testers. Their feedback shaped everything we did next—and today, we’re excited to kick-start the HIYD Gen 2 right here on Kickstarter!
story.z: 我们认为任何人都不必做出这样的选择。因此，我们构建了一些不需要您这样做的东西：HIYD。今年早些时候，我们将现场原型（我们称之为第一代）交付给真正的客户和测试人员。他们的反馈影响了我们接下来所做的一切——今天，我们很高兴能在 Kickstarter 上启动 HIYD Gen 2！

story.x: No notifications. No sounds. No lights. No Alarms. No distractions.
story.z: 没有通知。没有声音。没有灯。无警报。没有干扰。

story.x: Your watch looks exactly as it always has. Underneath, an optical window reads your pulse with red, infrared and green light. An accelerometer follows how you move. Together, they show how you sleep, recover, perform and more.
story.z: 您的手表看起来与以往一模一样。下面的光学窗口用红光、红外光和绿光读取您的脉搏。加速度计会跟踪您的移动方式。它们共同展示您的睡眠、恢复、表现等方面的情况。

story.x: What HIYD tracks
story.z: HIYD 追踪什么

story.x: *   Heart rate, resting heart rate and HRV. The clearest signals of stress and fitness.
story.z: * 心率、静息心率和 HRV。最清晰的压力和健康信号。

story.x: *   Blood oxygen, respiratory rate and skin temperature. Early signs that something is off, often before you feel it.
story.z: * 血氧、呼吸频率和皮肤温度。出现问题的早期迹象通常是在您感觉到之前。

story.x: *   Sleep score and stages. How long you slept, and how well.
story.z: * 睡眠分数和阶段。你睡了多久，睡得怎么样。

story.x: *   Daily readiness. Whether today is for pushing or for recovering.
story.z: * 日常准备。今天是为了推动还是为了恢复。

story.x: *   Steps, activity and VO2 max. Every day in the background, plus how your cardio fitness is improving.
story.z: * 步数、活动量和最大摄氧量。每天在后台，以及您的有氧运动的改善情况。

story.x: *   Cycle tracking. Know where you are in your cycle.
story.z: * 周期跟踪。了解您处于周期中的哪个位置。

story.x: *   Nutrition. Log calories and macros alongside your sleep and recovery.
story.z: * 营养。记录卡路里和宏指令以及您的睡眠和恢复情况。

story.x: *   Coach HIYD. An optional AI coach that explains your data in plain language. Free for life for backers.
story.z: * HIYD 教练。可选的人工智能教练，可以用简单的语言解释您的数据。支持者终身免费。

story.x: During our early pilot program, users tracked core health metrics including sleep quality, daily steps, and Heart Rate Variability (HRV). When benchmarked directly against top industry competitors, our field prototype architecture delivered matching accuracy across key metrics, proving that world-class health tracking doesn't require compromising on style.
story.z: 在我们的早期试点计划中，用户跟踪了核心健康指标，包括睡眠质量、每日步数和心率变异性 (HRV)。当直接与顶级行业竞争对手进行基准测试时，我们的现场原型架构在关键指标上提供了匹配的准确性，证明世界一流的健康跟踪不需要在风格上做出妥协。

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: 界面是一个带有一个按钮的戒指：按下它，说话，你的话语就会变成一条笔记、一条消息或对你的人工智能代理的请求，而无需拿出你的手机。它可与 iPhone 和 Android 上的 NatureOS 以及 Mac 或 Windows 计算机配合使用。

story.x: Without a Membership, Interface tracks your health and records your notes as audio. Every recording is sent automatically, as an audio file, to the AI you already use, through a webhook.
story.z: 如果没有会员资格，Interface 会跟踪您的健康状况并将您的笔记记录为音频。每个录音都会通过 Webhook 以音频文件的形式自动发送到您已经使用的 AI。

story.x: Membership ($9/month) adds our built-in AI: fast and accurate transcripts in 90+ languages, meeting recaps, dictation into any app, insights on your health, and a ready-to-use infrastructure for connecting multiple AI agents to your Interface. 3 to 6 months are included with your reward. If you stop, your ring keeps working with your own AI via webhook, and everything you recorded and transcribed stays yours.
story.z: 会员资格（9 美元/月）增加了我们的内置人工智能：90 多种语言的快速准确的文字记录、会议回顾、对任何应用程序的听写、对您健康状况的见解以及用于将多个人工智能代理连接到您的界面的即用型基础设施。您的奖励包含 3 至 6 个月。如果您停止，您的戒指将继续通过 webhook 与您自己的 AI 配合工作，并且您记录和转录的所有内容都属于您。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里窃窃私语，或者在音乐会上发言。当环境非常安静或非常吵闹时，将戒指靠近嘴唇。其余时间，无论手在哪里，都可以用手说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: 界面可读取您白天和晚上的心率、HRV、血氧、睡眠、皮肤温度和活动。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充品以及您的感受，您的人工智能将其与您的生物识别数据配对，为您提供量身定制的见解。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。询问后，您选择的代理就会帮您完成这项工作。任何重要的事情都等待您的批准，在 NatureOS 中您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
story.z: 在一个想法消失之前抓住它。口述一个想法、一个提醒或一个名称，然后在 NatureOS 中找到它，或者让您的代理为您组织它。

story.x: Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
story.z: 记录会议并获取完整的记录、谁说了什么，以及决策和后续步骤的回顾。稍后，问问你的决定。录音时，环上的灯会显示。

story.x: Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
story.z: 当您的手机放在口袋里时，即可通过 HumanPods 与您的客服人员交谈。提出问题、开始任务或听取更新。通过 Interface，按响铃并询问，然后在 HumanPods 中听到答复。

story.x: All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
story.z: 所有这些都集中在一枚不锈钢戒指上，经过拉丝处理，边缘抛光，适合每天佩戴。

story.x: Worn on your index finger, with the button facing your thumb. Waterproof.
story.z: 戴在食指上，按钮面向拇指。防水的。

story.x: A shockingly thin, fully mechanical keyboard. Altar II combines a superlative typing experience with an unbelievable design.
story.z: 超薄的全机械键盘。 Altar II 结合了最高级的打字体验和令人难以置信的设计。

story.x: The designer of Altar II discusses some of the design goals, background and difficulties of making Altar II a reality.
story.z: 《Altar II》的设计师讨论了一些设计目标、​​背景以及使《Altar II》成为现实的困难。

story.x: A brief overview of some Altar II functionality. Here it is shown pairing over Bluetooth and working with Sanctuary™, its native macOS companion app. We demonstrate using M-Dial™, remapping keys, and more, and give a general tour of the app. Shown on engineering prototype hardware with pre-alpha software and firmware.
story.z: Altar II 部分功能的简要概述。此处显示它通过蓝牙配对并与其本机 macOS 配套应用程序 Sanctuary™ 配合使用。我们演示如何使用 M-Dial™、重新映射按键等，并对该应用程序进行总体介绍。显示在带有 pre-alpha 软件和固件的工程原型硬件上。

story.x: The strikingly slim profile is enabled by breakthrough mechanical switch design — a dual steel-armed switch with a laterally arranged spring and 40gf actuation force.
story.z: 突破性的机械开关设计实现了惊人的纤薄外形——双钢臂开关，带有横向排列的弹簧和 40gf 的驱动力。

story.x: At 4.75mm, Altar II is the thinnest production mechanical keyboard ever made.
story.z: Altar II 厚度为 4.75 毫米，是有史以来最薄的量产机械键盘。

story.x: A magnetically detachable, clickable, swappable dial for volume, media and other controls. Two sizes of M-Dial™ are included in the box: Standard issue and low-profile.
story.z: 可磁性拆卸、可点击、可更换的音量、媒体和其他控制旋钮。包装盒中包含两种尺寸的 M-Dial™：标准型和低调型。

story.x: A haptic driver called Harmonic Synthesiser™ adds subtle physical feedback to typing, dial rotation, and keyboard state changes.
story.z: 称为 Harmonic Synthesiser™ 的触觉驱动器为打字、拨号盘旋转和键盘状态变化添加了微妙的物理反馈。

story.x: A fully native, Swift-based companion app for macOS gives full control over key mapping, backlight, haptics, audio and M-Dial™ functionality. Its lickable UI feels right at home on Mac.
story.z: 一款完全原生、基于 Swift 的 macOS 配套应用程序可以完全控制按键映射、背光、触觉、音频和 M-Dial™ 功能。其可爱的用户界面在 Mac 上给人一种宾至如归的感觉。

story.x: NiteLite™ is a red backlight that preserves night vision, and reduces eye strain by avoiding the blue light used in most keyboard backlights.
story.z: NiteLite™ 是一种红色背光灯，可保持夜视能力，并通过避免大多数键盘背光灯中使用的蓝光来减轻眼睛疲劳。

story.x: A two-layer Inertial Damper™ system isolates the typing platform and gives Altar II a unique typing sound and feel.
story.z: 两层 Inertial Damper™ 系统隔离打字平台，并为 Altar II 带来独特的打字声音和感觉。

story.x: Every element of Altar II — key shape, layout, typography, materials, footprint — is painstakingly designed, down to the last detail.
story.z: 《Altar II》的每一个元素——关键形状、布局、排版、材料、占地面积——都经过精心设计，直至最后一个细节。

story.x: Altar II's slimline chassis keeps wrists almost flat during typing, reducing the strain associated with most keyboards, and negating the need for angling the typing platform.
story.z: Altar II 的纤薄底盘使手腕在打字时几乎保持平坦，减少了大多数键盘带来的压力，并且无需调整打字平台的角度。

story.x: Fitting a full mechanical keyboard, battery, haptic system, speaker, and wireless radio into a sub-5mm chassis required bleeding-edge engineering and effort.
story.z: 将全机械键盘、电池、触觉系统、扬声器和无线电装置安装到 5 毫米以下的底盘中需要尖端的工程技术和努力。

story.x: Altar II is made from recycled plastic and recyclable aluminium, and ships in completely plastic-free packaging.

story.x: A shockingly thin, fully mechanical keyboard. Altar II combines a superlative typing experience with an unbelievable design.
story.z: 超薄的全机械键盘。 Altar II 结合了最高级的打字体验和令人难以置信的设计。

story.x: The designer of Altar II discusses some of the design goals, background and difficulties of making Altar II a reality.
story.z: 《Altar II》的设计师讨论了一些设计目标、​​背景以及使《Altar II》成为现实的困难。

story.x: A brief overview of some Altar II functionality. Here it is shown pairing over Bluetooth and working with Sanctuary™, its native macOS companion app. We demonstrate using M-Dial™, remapping keys, and more, and give a general tour of the app. Shown on engineering prototype hardware with pre-alpha software and firmware.
story.z: Altar II 部分功能的简要概述。此处显示它通过蓝牙配对并与其本机 macOS 配套应用程序 Sanctuary™ 配合使用。我们演示如何使用 M-Dial™、重新映射按键等，并对该应用程序进行总体介绍。显示在带有 pre-alpha 软件和固件的工程原型硬件上。

story.x: The strikingly slim profile is enabled by breakthrough mechanical switch design — a dual steel-armed switch with a laterally arranged spring and 40gf actuation force.
story.z: 突破性的机械开关设计实现了惊人的纤薄外形——双钢臂开关，带有横向排列的弹簧和 40gf 的驱动力。

story.x: At 4.75mm, Altar II is the thinnest production mechanical keyboard ever made.
story.z: Altar II 厚度为 4.75 毫米，是有史以来最薄的量产机械键盘。

story.x: A magnetically detachable, clickable, swappable dial for volume, media and other controls. Two sizes of M-Dial™ are included in the box: Standard issue and low-profile.
story.z: 可磁性拆卸、可点击、可更换的音量、媒体和其他控制旋钮。包装盒中包含两种尺寸的 M-Dial™：标准型和低调型。

story.x: A haptic driver called Harmonic Synthesiser™ adds subtle physical feedback to typing, dial rotation, and keyboard state changes.
story.z: 称为 Harmonic Synthesiser™ 的触觉驱动器为打字、拨号盘旋转和键盘状态变化添加了微妙的物理反馈。

story.x: A fully native, Swift-based companion app for macOS gives full control over key mapping, backlight, haptics, audio and M-Dial™ functionality. Its lickable UI feels right at home on Mac.
story.z: 一款完全原生、基于 Swift 的 macOS 配套应用程序可以完全控制按键映射、背光、触觉、音频和 M-Dial™ 功能。其可爱的用户界面在 Mac 上给人一种宾至如归的感觉。

story.x: NiteLite™ is a red backlight that preserves night vision, and reduces eye strain by avoiding the blue light used in most keyboard backlights.
story.z: NiteLite™ 是一种红色背光灯，可保持夜视能力，并通过避免大多数键盘背光灯中使用的蓝光来减轻眼睛疲劳。

story.x: A two-layer Inertial Damper™ system isolates the typing platform and gives Altar II a unique typing sound and feel.
story.z: 两层 Inertial Damper™ 系统隔离打字平台，并为 Altar II 带来独特的打字声音和感觉。

story.x: Every element of Altar II — key shape, layout, typography, materials, footprint — is painstakingly designed, down to the last detail.
story.z: 《Altar II》的每一个元素——关键形状、布局、排版、材料、占地面积——都经过精心设计，直至最后一个细节。

story.x: Altar II's slimline chassis keeps wrists almost flat during typing, reducing the strain associated with most keyboards, and negating the need for angling the typing platform.
story.z: Altar II 的纤薄底盘使手腕在打字时几乎保持平坦，减少了大多数键盘带来的压力，并且无需调整打字平台的角度。

story.x: Fitting a full mechanical keyboard, battery, haptic system, speaker, and wireless radio into a sub-5mm chassis required bleeding-edge engineering and effort.
story.z: 将全机械键盘、电池、触觉系统、扬声器和无线电装置安装到 5 毫米以下的底盘中需要尖端的工程技术和努力。

story.x: Altar II is made from recycled plastic and recyclable aluminium, and ships in completely plastic-free packaging.

story.x: Smartwatches ask you to trade all that for a screen and distractions. Plenty of us tried. Most of us went back to the watches we love.
story.z: 智能手表要求你用所有这些来换取屏幕和干扰。我们很多人都尝试过。我们大多数人都回到了我们喜爱的手表上。

story.x: Smart rings and fitness bands aren't much better. A band means wearing something on your other wrist. A ring can feel bulky and strange. Neither was designed around your style. And many people, us included, simply find them uncomfortable and ugly.
story.z: 智能戒指和健身手环也好不了多少。腕带意味着在另一只手腕上佩戴一些东西。戒指给人的感觉是笨重且奇怪。两者都不是根据您的风格设计的。许多人，包括我们，只是觉得它们不舒服而且丑陋。

story.x: So you're left with a choice: The watch you love, or knowing how you sleep, recover and perform...
story.z: 因此，您面临的选择是：您喜爱的手表，或者了解您的睡眠、恢复和表现情况......

story.x: We're a team of ex Apple, Tesla and YC engineers who love watches ourselves.
story.z: 我们是一支由前 Apple、Tesla 和 YC 工程师组成的团队，他们自己也热爱手表。

story.x: We didn't think anyone should have to make that choice. So we built something that doesn't ask you to: HIYD. Earlier this year, we put our field prototype (which we called our Gen 1) into the hands of real customers and testers. Their feedback shaped everything we did next—and today, we’re excited to kick-start the HIYD Gen 2 right here on Kickstarter!
story.z: 我们认为任何人都不必做出这样的选择。因此，我们构建了一些不需要您这样做的东西：HIYD。今年早些时候，我们将现场原型（我们称之为第一代）交付给真正的客户和测试人员。他们的反馈影响了我们接下来所做的一切——今天，我们很高兴能在 Kickstarter 上启动 HIYD Gen 2！

story.x: No notifications. No sounds. No lights. No Alarms. No distractions.
story.z: 没有通知。没有声音。没有灯。无警报。没有干扰。

story.x: Your watch looks exactly as it always has. Underneath, an optical window reads your pulse with red, infrared and green light. An accelerometer follows how you move. Together, they show how you sleep, recover, perform and more.
story.z: 您的手表看起来与以往一模一样。下面的光学窗口用红光、红外光和绿光读取您的脉搏。加速度计会跟踪您的移动方式。它们共同展示您的睡眠、恢复、表现等方面的情况。

story.x: What HIYD tracks
story.z: HIYD 追踪什么

story.x: *   Heart rate, resting heart rate and HRV. The clearest signals of stress and fitness.
story.z: * 心率、静息心率和 HRV。最清晰的压力和健康信号。

story.x: *   Blood oxygen, respiratory rate and skin temperature. Early signs that something is off, often before you feel it.
story.z: * 血氧、呼吸频率和皮肤温度。出现问题的早期迹象通常是在您感觉到之前。

story.x: *   Sleep score and stages. How long you slept, and how well.
story.z: * 睡眠分数和阶段。你睡了多久，睡得怎么样。

story.x: *   Daily readiness. Whether today is for pushing or for recovering.
story.z: * 日常准备。今天是为了推动还是为了恢复。

story.x: *   Steps, activity and VO2 max. Every day in the background, plus how your cardio fitness is improving.
story.z: * 步数、活动量和最大摄氧量。每天在后台，以及您的有氧运动的改善情况。

story.x: *   Cycle tracking. Know where you are in your cycle.
story.z: * 周期跟踪。了解您处于周期中的哪个位置。

story.x: *   Nutrition. Log calories and macros alongside your sleep and recovery.
story.z: * 营养。记录卡路里和宏指令以及您的睡眠和恢复情况。

story.x: *   Coach HIYD. An optional AI coach that explains your data in plain language. Free for life for backers.
story.z: * HIYD 教练。可选的人工智能教练，可以用简单的语言解释您的数据。支持者终身免费。

story.x: During our early pilot program, users tracked core health metrics including sleep quality, daily steps, and Heart Rate Variability (HRV). When benchmarked directly against top industry competitors, our field prototype architecture delivered matching accuracy across key metrics, proving that world-class health tracking doesn't require compromising on style.
story.z: 在我们的早期试点计划中，用户跟踪了核心健康指标，包括睡眠质量、每日步数和心率变异性 (HRV)。当直接与顶级行业竞争对手进行基准测试时，我们的现场原型架构在关键指标上提供了匹配的准确性，证明世界一流的健康跟踪不需要在风格上做出妥协。

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: 界面是一个带有一个按钮的戒指：按下它，说话，你的话语就会变成一条笔记、一条消息或对你的人工智能代理的请求，而无需拿出你的手机。它可与 iPhone 和 Android 上的 NatureOS 以及 Mac 或 Windows 计算机配合使用。

story.x: Without a Membership, Interface tracks your health and records your notes as audio. Every recording is sent automatically, as an audio file, to the AI you already use, through a webhook.
story.z: 如果没有会员资格，Interface 会跟踪您的健康状况并将您的笔记记录为音频。每个录音都会通过 Webhook 以音频文件的形式自动发送到您已经使用的 AI。

story.x: Membership ($9/month) adds our built-in AI: fast and accurate transcripts in 90+ languages, meeting recaps, dictation into any app, insights on your health, and a ready-to-use infrastructure for connecting multiple AI agents to your Interface. 3 to 6 months are included with your reward. If you stop, your ring keeps working with your own AI via webhook, and everything you recorded and transcribed stays yours.
story.z: 会员资格（9 美元/月）增加了我们的内置人工智能：90 多种语言的快速准确的文字记录、会议回顾、对任何应用程序的听写、对您健康状况的见解以及用于将多个人工智能代理连接到您的界面的即用型基础设施。您的奖励包含 3 至 6 个月。如果您停止，您的戒指将继续通过 webhook 与您自己的 AI 配合工作，并且您记录和转录的所有内容都属于您。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里窃窃私语，或者在音乐会上发言。当环境非常安静或非常吵闹时，将戒指靠近嘴唇。其余时间，无论手在哪里，都可以用手说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: 界面可读取您白天和晚上的心率、HRV、血氧、睡眠、皮肤温度和活动。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充品以及您的感受，您的人工智能将其与您的生物识别数据配对，为您提供量身定制的见解。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。询问后，您选择的代理就会帮您完成这项工作。任何重要的事情都等待您的批准，在 NatureOS 中您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
story.z: 在一个想法消失之前抓住它。口述一个想法、一个提醒或一个名称，然后在 NatureOS 中找到它，或者让您的代理为您组织它。

story.x: Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
story.z: 记录会议并获取完整的记录、谁说了什么，以及决策和后续步骤的回顾。稍后，问问你的决定。录音时，环上的灯会显示。

story.x: Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
story.z: 当您的手机放在口袋里时，即可通过 HumanPods 与您的客服人员交谈。提出问题、开始任务或听取更新。通过 Interface，按响铃并询问，然后在 HumanPods 中听到答复。

story.x: All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
story.z: 所有这些都集中在一枚不锈钢戒指上，经过拉丝处理，边缘抛光，适合每天佩戴。

story.x: Worn on your index finger, with the button facing your thumb. Waterproof.
story.z: 戴在食指上，按钮面向拇指。防水的。

story.x: VIP Cashback Rules: Please pay the standard pledge amount upfront at checkout. The $50 VIP discount will be refunded to your original payment account after your printer is shipped.

story.x: Multiple VIPs & Printers: Each VIP reservation unlocks a $50 refund for one printer. For example, if you reserve 2 VIP spots and pledge for 2 printers, you will receive a total refund of $100 after shipment.

story.x: True 8-tool switching architecture for seamless multi-color and multi-material printing. Eliminates filament waste towers and significantly accelerates execution times.
story.z: 真正的 8 工具切换架构，可实现无缝多色和多材料打印。消除了废丝塔并显着加快了执行时间。

story.x: Engineered for seamless multi-material and multi-color execution, the InfiMech MX Series features an array of independent tool docks with individual filament pathways.
story.z: InfiMech MX 系列专为无缝多材料和多颜色执行而设计，具有一系列带有单独灯丝路径的独立工具坞。

story.x: *   Dedicated Channel Design: Each tool maintains an independent filament path, preventing cross-contamination and eliminating multi-color bleed.
story.z: * 专用通道设计：每个工具都保持独立的灯丝路径，防止交叉污染并消除多色渗色。

story.x: *   Precision Mechanical Alignment: High-precision guide rails and docking mechanisms ensure reliable tool pickup and release with sub-millimeter repeatable accuracy.
story.z: * 精密机械对准：高精度导轨和对接机构确保可靠的工具拾取和释放，具有亚毫米可重复精度。

story.x: *   Streamlined Filament Management: Integrated PTFE routing and sensors ensure smooth filament feeding and instant strain detection.
story.z: * 简化的灯丝管理：集成的 PTFE 布线和传感器确保灯丝顺利进给和即时应变检测。

story.x: Unlike traditional single-nozzle systems that purge material during every single color swap, the InfiMech MX Series utilizes a smart independent tool architecture.
story.z: 与在每次单一颜色交换期间清除材料的传统单喷嘴系统不同，InfiMech MX 系列采用智能独立工具架构。

story.x: *   One Priming Per Tool: Each tool purges only once upon its first activation to ensure the melt zone is perfectly filled.
story.z: * 每个工具一次灌注：每个工具在首次激活时仅清洗一次，以确保熔化区域完美填充。

story.x: *   No Repeated Purging: Subsequent color switches require no further filament waste throughout the entire print.
story.z: * 无需重复清洗：后续颜色切换不需要在整个打印过程中进一步浪费灯丝。

story.x: *   Maximum Waste Reduction: Printing an 8-color model produces only 8 small purge drops in total—reducing material waste and printing time to the absolute minimum.
story.z: * 最大程度地减少浪费：打印 8 色模型总共仅产生 8 个小清洗滴，将材料浪费和打印时间减少到绝对最低限度。

story.x: Cutting-edge electromagnetic induction technology rockets nozzle temperatures from ambient to operating heat in just 8 seconds, eliminating prep waiting times and optimizing multi-tool efficiency.
story.z: 尖端的电磁感应技术只需 8 秒即可将喷嘴温度从环境温度升高到工作温度，从而消除了准备等待时间并优化了多工具效率。

story.x: Reads precise thermal data using high-accuracy thermistors and transmits signal via NFC. No physical pins to wear out, no wiring clutter, and zero connection errors during tool swaps.
story.z: 使用高精度热敏电阻读取精确的热数据并通过 NFC 传输信号。没有物理引脚磨损，没有接线混乱，工具交换期间连接错误为零。

story.x: Dedicated printhead sensor actively detects hotend filament buildup in real time. Automatically pauses printing and triggers an on-screen alert to prevent hotend destruction and component damage.
story.z: 专用打印头传感器实时主动检测热端丝堆积情况。自动暂停打印并触发屏幕警报，以防止热端损坏和组件损坏。

story.x: Tool-integrated Hall sensor monitors filament feed tension in real time. Automatically pauses printing and prompts on-screen alerts when a spool tangle is detected, protecting your extruder and saving long prints.
story.z: 工具集成的霍尔传感器实时监控细丝进给张力。当检测到线轴缠结时，自动暂停打印并在屏幕上提示警报，从而保护您的挤出机并节省长打印件。

story.x: Automatically pauses printing when the filament spool rns out, saving your job and allowing instant spool replacements.
story.z: 当耗材线轴用完时，自动暂停打印，从而节省您的工作并允许即时更换线轴。

story.x: Auxiliary Part Cooling: A dedicated interior side fan delivers targeted high-volume airflow across the build platform. Enhances overhangs, bridging, and surface finish at extreme speeds without adding weight to the tool.
story.z: 辅助部件冷却：专用的内侧风扇在整个构建平台上提供有针对性的大流量气流。以极快的速度增强悬伸、桥接和表面光洁度，而不增加工具的重量。

story.x: Saves printing status and coordinates in non-volatile memory during unexpected blackouts. Prompts a one-touch resume upon power restoration to save time, energy, and filament.
story.z: 在意外停电期间将打印状态和坐标保存在非易失性存储器中。电源恢复后提示一键恢复，以节省时间、能源和灯丝。

story.x: AI-assisted camera monitoring that automatically pauses execution when prints fail.
story.z: AI辅助摄像头监控，打印失败时自动暂停执行。

story.x: Visual bed inspection that detects left-over tools or debris before homing to prevent nozzle crashes.
story.z: 目视床检查可在归位前检测剩余的工具或碎片，以防止喷嘴碰撞。

story.x: Precision Tool Calibration:Multi-point perimeter probing → Instant exact center calculation for absolute alignment on every tool swap.
story.z: 精密工具校准：多点周边探测 → 即时精确中心计算，以便在每次工具交换时实现绝对对准。

story.x: Actively warms the build enclosure up to 60–65°C. Prevents shrinkage, layer delamination, and warping when printing engineering materials like ABS, ASA, PC, and Nylon.
story.z: 主动将构建外壳加热至 60–65°C。打印 ABS、ASA、PC 和尼龙等工程材料时，可防止收缩、分层和翘曲。

story.x: Filters out fine particulates and absorbs harmful fumes and odors. Designed for safer indoor printing with high-temp materials like ABS and ASA.
story.z: 过滤掉细颗粒并吸收有害烟雾和气味。专为使用 ABS 和 ASA 等高温材料进行更安全的室内打印而设计。

story.x: Powered by high-precision closed-loop motors with real-time encoder feedback, the InfiMech MX Series eliminates layer shift caused by accidental bumps or external interference.
story.z: InfiMech MX 系列由具有实时编码器反馈的高精度闭环电机提供动力，消除了因意外碰撞或外部干扰而导致的层移位。

story.x: *   Real-Time Step Tracking: High-resolution encoders continuously monitor motor positions to detect any physical displacement immediately.
story.z: * 实时步进跟踪：高分辨率编码器持续监控电机位置，以立即检测任何物理位移。

story.x: *   Instant Auto-Recovery: If bumped or pushed out of place, the system compensates in milliseconds, automatically driving the tool back to its exact trajectory to save your print.
story.z: * 即时自动恢复：如果碰撞或推离原位，系统会在几毫秒内进行补偿，自动将工具驱动回其精确轨迹以保存打印。

story.x: A shockingly thin, fully mechanical keyboard. Altar II combines a superlative typing experience with an unbelievable design.
story.z: 超薄的全机械键盘。 Altar II 结合了最高级的打字体验和令人难以置信的设计。

story.x: The designer of Altar II discusses some of the design goals, background and difficulties of making Altar II a reality.
story.z: 《Altar II》的设计师讨论了一些设计目标、​​背景以及使《Altar II》成为现实的困难。

story.x: A brief overview of some Altar II functionality. Here it is shown pairing over Bluetooth and working with Sanctuary™, its native macOS companion app. We demonstrate using M-Dial™, remapping keys, and more, and give a general tour of the app. Shown on engineering prototype hardware with pre-alpha software and firmware.
story.z: Altar II 部分功能的简要概述。此处显示它通过蓝牙配对并与其本机 macOS 配套应用程序 Sanctuary™ 配合使用。我们演示如何使用 M-Dial™、重新映射按键等，并对该应用程序进行总体介绍。显示在带有 pre-alpha 软件和固件的工程原型硬件上。

story.x: The strikingly slim profile is enabled by breakthrough mechanical switch design — a dual steel-armed switch with a laterally arranged spring and 40gf actuation force.
story.z: 突破性的机械开关设计实现了惊人的纤薄外形——双钢臂开关，带有横向排列的弹簧和 40gf 的驱动力。

story.x: At 4.75mm, Altar II is the thinnest production mechanical keyboard ever made.
story.z: Altar II 厚度为 4.75 毫米，是有史以来最薄的量产机械键盘。

story.x: A magnetically detachable, clickable, swappable dial for volume, media and other controls. Two sizes of M-Dial™ are included in the box: Standard issue and low-profile.
story.z: 可磁性拆卸、可点击、可更换的音量、媒体和其他控制旋钮。包装盒中包含两种尺寸的 M-Dial™：标准型和低调型。

story.x: A haptic driver called Harmonic Synthesiser™ adds subtle physical feedback to typing, dial rotation, and keyboard state changes.
story.z: 称为 Harmonic Synthesiser™ 的触觉驱动器为打字、拨号盘旋转和键盘状态变化添加了微妙的物理反馈。

story.x: A fully native, Swift-based companion app for macOS gives full control over key mapping, backlight, haptics, audio and M-Dial™ functionality. Its lickable UI feels right at home on Mac.
story.z: 一款完全原生、基于 Swift 的 macOS 配套应用程序可以完全控制按键映射、背光、触觉、音频和 M-Dial™ 功能。其可爱的用户界面在 Mac 上给人一种宾至如归的感觉。

story.x: NiteLite™ is a red backlight that preserves night vision, and reduces eye strain by avoiding the blue light used in most keyboard backlights.
story.z: NiteLite™ 是一种红色背光灯，可保持夜视能力，并通过避免大多数键盘背光灯中使用的蓝光来减轻眼睛疲劳。

story.x: A two-layer Inertial Damper™ system isolates the typing platform and gives Altar II a unique typing sound and feel.
story.z: 两层 Inertial Damper™ 系统隔离打字平台，并赋予 Altar II 独特的打字声音和感觉。

story.x: Every element of Altar II — key shape, layout, typography, materials, footprint — is painstakingly designed, down to the last detail.
story.z: 《Altar II》的每一个元素——关键形状、布局、排版、材料、占地面积——都经过精心设计，直至最后一个细节。

story.x: Altar II's slimline chassis keeps wrists almost flat during typing, reducing the strain associated with most keyboards, and negating the need for angling the typing platform.
story.z: Altar II 的纤薄底盘使手腕在打字时几乎保持平坦，减少了大多数键盘带来的压力，并且无需调整打字平台的角度。

story.x: Fitting a full mechanical keyboard, battery, haptic system, speaker, and wireless radio into a sub-5mm chassis required bleeding-edge engineering and effort.
story.z: 将全机械键盘、电池、触觉系统、扬声器和无线电装置安装到 5 毫米以下的底盘中需要尖端的工程技术和努力。

story.x: Altar II is made from recycled plastic and recyclable aluminium, and ships in completely plastic-free packaging.
story.z: Altar II 由回收塑料和可回收铝制成，并采用完全不含塑料的包装运输。

story.x: Up to 30 days of typical use on a single charge, with two days of usage from two minutes of charging over USB-C.
story.z: 一次充电典型使用时间长达 30 天，通过 USB-C 充电两分钟即可使用两天。

story.x: Altar II keyboard, coiled USB-C cable, two M-Dials (standard issue and low profile), field manual, and EMO stickers.
story.z: Altar II 键盘、USB-C 盘绕线、两个 M-Dial（标准版和低调版）、现场手册和 EMO 贴纸。

story.x: Recorded on pre-production hardware with Zoom H5, 24-bit/48kHz, XY stereo, 40cm above device, 80Hz high-pass.
story.z: 使用 Zoom H5、24 位/48kHz、XY 立体声、设备上方 40 厘米、80Hz 高通在预制作硬件上录制。

story.x: Smartwatches ask you to trade all that for a screen and distractions. Plenty of us tried. Most of us went back to the watches we love.
story.z: 智能手表要求你用所有这些来换取屏幕和干扰。我们很多人都尝试过。我们大多数人都回到了我们喜爱的手表上。

story.x: Smart rings and fitness bands aren't much better. A band means wearing something on your other wrist. A ring can feel bulky and strange. Neither was designed around your style. And many people, us included, simply find them uncomfortable and ugly.
story.z: 智能戒指和健身手环也好不了多少。腕带意味着在另一只手腕上佩戴一些东西。戒指给人的感觉是笨重且奇怪。两者都不是根据您的风格设计的。许多人，包括我们，只是觉得它们不舒服而且丑陋。

story.x: So you're left with a choice: The watch you love, or knowing how you sleep, recover and perform...
story.z: 因此，您面临的选择是：您喜爱的手表，或者了解您的睡眠、恢复和表现情况......

story.x: We're a team of ex Apple, Tesla and YC engineers who love watches ourselves.
story.z: 我们是一支由前 Apple、Tesla 和 YC 工程师组成的团队，他们自己也热爱手表。

story.x: We didn't think anyone should have to make that choice. So we built something that doesn't ask you to: HIYD. Earlier this year, we put our field prototype (which we called our Gen 1) into the hands of real customers and testers. Their feedback shaped everything we did next—and today, we’re excited to kick-start the HIYD Gen 2 right here on Kickstarter!
story.z: 我们认为任何人都不必做出这样的选择。因此，我们构建了一些不需要您这样做的东西：HIYD。今年早些时候，我们将现场原型（我们称之为第一代）交付给真正的客户和测试人员。他们的反馈影响了我们接下来所做的一切——今天，我们很高兴能在 Kickstarter 上启动 HIYD Gen 2！

story.x: No notifications. No sounds. No lights. No Alarms. No distractions.
story.z: 没有通知。没有声音。没有灯。无警报。没有干扰。

story.x: Your watch looks exactly as it always has. Underneath, an optical window reads your pulse with red, infrared and green light. An accelerometer follows how you move. Together, they show how you sleep, recover, perform and more.
story.z: 您的手表看起来与以往一模一样。下面的光学窗口用红光、红外光和绿光读取您的脉搏。加速度计会跟踪您的移动方式。它们共同展示您的睡眠、恢复、表现等方面的情况。

story.x: What HIYD tracks
story.z: HIYD 追踪什么

story.x: *   Heart rate, resting heart rate and HRV. The clearest signals of stress and fitness.
story.z: * 心率、静息心率和 HRV。最清晰的压力和健康信号。

story.x: *   Blood oxygen, respiratory rate and skin temperature. Early signs that something is off, often before you feel it.
story.z: * 血氧、呼吸频率和皮肤温度。出现问题的早期迹象通常是在您感觉到之前。

story.x: *   Sleep score and stages. How long you slept, and how well.
story.z: * 睡眠分数和阶段。你睡了多久，睡得怎么样。

story.x: *   Daily readiness. Whether today is for pushing or for recovering.
story.z: * 日常准备。今天是为了推动还是为了恢复。

story.x: *   Steps, activity and VO2 max. Every day in the background, plus how your cardio fitness is improving.
story.z: * 步数、活动量和最大摄氧量。每天在后台，以及您的有氧运动的改善情况。

story.x: *   Cycle tracking. Know where you are in your cycle.
story.z: * 周期跟踪。了解您处于周期中的哪个位置。

story.x: *   Nutrition. Log calories and macros alongside your sleep and recovery.
story.z: * 营养。记录卡路里和宏指令以及您的睡眠和恢复情况。

story.x: *   Coach HIYD. An optional AI coach that explains your data in plain language. Free for life for backers.
story.z: * HIYD 教练。可选的人工智能教练，可以用简单的语言解释您的数据。支持者终身免费。

story.x: During our early pilot program, users tracked core health metrics including sleep quality, daily steps, and Heart Rate Variability (HRV). When benchmarked directly against top industry competitors, our field prototype architecture delivered matching accuracy across key metrics, proving that world-class health tracking doesn't require compromising on style.
story.z: 在我们的早期试点计划中，用户跟踪了核心健康指标，包括睡眠质量、每日步数和心率变异性 (HRV)。当直接与顶级行业竞争对手进行基准测试时，我们的现场原型架构在关键指标上提供了匹配的准确性，证明世界一流的健康跟踪不需要在风格上做出妥协。

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: 界面是一个带有一个按钮的戒指：按下它，说话，你的话语就会变成一条笔记、一条消息或对你的人工智能代理的请求，而无需拿出你的手机。它可与 iPhone 和 Android 上的 NatureOS 以及 Mac 或 Windows 计算机配合使用。

story.x: Phones gave us everything, and took our attention in return. We wanted the opposite: technology you can use while staying in the moment. So we put the most useful things you do with your phone behind one button on your finger.
story.z: 手机给了我们一切，也吸引了我们的注意力。我们想要相反的东西：您可以在专注于当下的同时使用技术。因此，我们将您使用手机执行的最有用的操作放在手指上的一个按钮后面。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里窃窃私语，或者在音乐会上发言。当环境非常安静或非常吵闹时，将戒指靠近嘴唇。其余时间，无论手在哪里，都可以用手说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: 界面可读取您白天和晚上的心率、HRV、血氧、睡眠、皮肤温度和活动。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充品以及您的感受，您的人工智能将其与您的生物识别数据配对，为您提供量身定制的见解。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。询问后，您选择的代理就会帮您完成这项工作。任何重要的事情都等待您的批准，在 NatureOS 中您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
story.z: 在一个想法消失之前抓住它。口述一个想法、一个提醒或一个名称，然后在 NatureOS 中找到它，或者让您的代理为您组织它。

story.x: Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
story.z: 记录一次会议并获取完整的记录、谁说了什么，以及决策和后续步骤的回顾。稍后，问问你的决定。录音时，环上的灯会显示。

story.x: Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
story.z: 当您的手机放在口袋里时，即可通过 HumanPods 与您的客服人员交谈。提出问题、开始任务或听取更新。通过 Interface，按响铃并询问，然后在 HumanPods 中听到答复。

story.x: All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
story.z: 所有这些都集中在一枚不锈钢戒指上，经过拉丝处理，边缘抛光，适合每天佩戴。

story.x: Worn on your index finger, with the button facing your thumb. Waterproof.
story.z: 戴在食指上，按钮面向拇指。防水的。

story.x: Interface only records while you press the button, and a light shows when it does. Nothing is recorded without your approval.
story.z: 界面仅在您按下按钮时进行记录，按下按钮时指示灯会亮起。未经您的批准，不会记录任何内容。

story.x: A shockingly thin, fully mechanical keyboard. Altar II combines a superlative typing experience with an unbelievable design.
story.z: 超薄的全机械键盘。 Altar II 结合了最高级的打字体验和令人难以置信的设计。

story.x: The designer of Altar II discusses some of the design goals, background and difficulties of making Altar II a reality.
story.z: 《Altar II》的设计师讨论了一些设计目标、​​背景以及使《Altar II》成为现实的困难。

story.x: A brief overview of some Altar II functionality. Here it is shown pairing over Bluetooth and working with Sanctuary™, its native macOS companion app. We demonstrate using M-Dial™, remapping keys, and more, and give a general tour of the app. Shown on engineering prototype hardware with pre-alpha software and firmware.
story.z: Altar II 部分功能的简要概述。此处显示它通过蓝牙配对并与其本机 macOS 配套应用程序 Sanctuary™ 配合使用。我们演示如何使用 M-Dial™、重新映射按键等，并对该应用程序进行总体介绍。显示在带有 pre-alpha 软件和固件的工程原型硬件上。

story.x: The strikingly slim profile is enabled by breakthrough mechanical switch design — a dual steel-armed switch with a laterally arranged spring and 40gf actuation force.
story.z: 突破性的机械开关设计实现了惊人的纤薄外形——双钢臂开关，带有横向排列的弹簧和 40gf 的驱动力。

story.x: At 4.75mm, Altar II is the thinnest production mechanical keyboard ever made.
story.z: Altar II 厚度为 4.75 毫米，是有史以来最薄的量产机械键盘。

story.x: A magnetically detachable, clickable, swappable dial for volume, media and other controls. Two sizes of M-Dial™ are included in the box: Standard issue and low-profile.
story.z: 可磁性拆卸、可点击、可更换的音量、媒体和其他控制旋钮。包装盒中包含两种尺寸的 M-Dial™：标准型和低调型。

story.x: A haptic driver called Harmonic Synthesiser™ adds subtle physical feedback to typing, dial rotation, and keyboard state changes.
story.z: 称为 Harmonic Synthesiser™ 的触觉驱动器为打字、拨号盘旋转和键盘状态变化添加了微妙的物理反馈。

story.x: A fully native, Swift-based companion app for macOS gives full control over key mapping, backlight, haptics, audio and M-Dial™ functionality. Its lickable UI feels right at home on Mac.
story.z: 一款完全原生、基于 Swift 的 macOS 配套应用程序可以完全控制按键映射、背光、触觉、音频和 M-Dial™ 功能。其可爱的用户界面在 Mac 上给人一种宾至如归的感觉。

story.x: NiteLite™ is a red backlight that preserves night vision, and reduces eye strain by avoiding the blue light used in most keyboard backlights.
story.z: NiteLite™ 是一种红色背光灯，可保持夜视能力，并通过避免大多数键盘背光灯中使用的蓝光来减轻眼睛疲劳。

story.x: A two-layer Inertial Damper™ system isolates the typing platform and gives Altar II a unique typing sound and feel.
story.z: 两层 Inertial Damper™ 系统隔离打字平台，并为 Altar II 带来独特的打字声音和感觉。

story.x: Every element of Altar II — key shape, layout, typography, materials, footprint — is painstakingly designed, down to the last detail.
story.z: 《Altar II》的每一个元素——关键形状、布局、排版、材料、占地面积——都经过精心设计，直至最后一个细节。

story.x: Altar II's slimline chassis keeps wrists almost flat during typing, reducing the strain associated with most keyboards, and negating the need for angling the typing platform.
story.z: Altar II 的纤薄底盘使手腕在打字时几乎保持平坦，减少了大多数键盘带来的压力，并且无需调整打字平台的角度。

story.x: Fitting a full mechanical keyboard, battery, haptic system, speaker, and wireless radio into a sub-5mm chassis required bleeding-edge engineering and effort.
story.z: 将全机械键盘、电池、触觉系统、扬声器和无线电装置安装到 5 毫米以下的底盘中需要尖端的工程技术和努力。

story.x: Altar II is made from recycled plastic and recyclable aluminium, and ships in completely plastic-free packaging.
story.z: Altar II 由回收塑料和可回收铝制成，并采用完全不含塑料的包装运输。

story.x: Up to 30 days of typical use on a single charge, with two days of usage from two minutes of charging over USB-C.
story.z: 一次充电典型使用时间长达 30 天，通过 USB-C 充电两分钟即可使用两天。

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: 界面是一个带有一个按钮的戒指：按下它，说话，你的话语就会变成一条笔记、一条消息或对你的人工智能代理的请求，而无需拿出你的手机。它可与 iPhone 和 Android 上的 NatureOS 以及 Mac 或 Windows 计算机配合使用。

story.x: Phones gave us everything, and took our attention in return. We wanted the opposite: technology you can use while staying in the moment. So we put the most useful things you do with your phone behind one button on your finger.
story.z: 手机给了我们一切，也吸引了我们的注意力。我们想要相反的东西：您可以在专注于当下的同时使用技术。因此，我们将您使用手机执行的最有用的操作放在手指上的一个按钮后面。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里窃窃私语，或者在音乐会上发言。当环境非常安静或非常吵闹时，将戒指靠近嘴唇。其余时间，无论手在哪里，都可以用手说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: 界面可读取您白天和晚上的心率、HRV、血氧、睡眠、皮肤温度和活动。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充品以及您的感受，您的人工智能将其与您的生物识别数据配对，为您提供量身定制的见解。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。询问后，您选择的代理就会帮您完成这项工作。任何重要的事情都等待您的批准，在 NatureOS 中您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
story.z: 在一个想法消失之前抓住它。口述一个想法、一个提醒或一个名称，然后在 NatureOS 中找到它，或者让您的代理为您组织它。

story.x: Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
story.z: 记录会议并获取完整的记录、谁说了什么，以及决策和后续步骤的回顾。稍后，问问你的决定。录音时，环上的灯会显示。

story.x: Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
story.z: 当您的手机放在口袋里时，即可通过 HumanPods 与您的客服人员交谈。提出问题、开始任务或听取更新。通过 Interface，按响铃并询问，然后在 HumanPods 中听到答复。

story.x: All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
story.z: 所有这些都集中在一枚不锈钢戒指上，经过拉丝处理，边缘抛光，适合每天佩戴。

story.x: Worn on your index finger, with the button facing your thumb. Waterproof.
story.z: 戴在食指上，按钮面向拇指。防水的。

story.x: Interface only records while you press the button, and a light shows when it does. Nothing is recorded without your approval.
story.z: 界面仅在您按下按钮时进行记录，按下按钮时指示灯会亮起。未经您的批准，不会记录任何内容。

story.x: At 4.75mm, Altar II is the thinnest production mechanical keyboard ever made.

story.x: A magnetically detachable, clickable, swappable dial for volume, media and other controls. Two sizes of M-Dial™ are included in the box: Standard issue and low-profile.
story.z: 可磁吸拆卸、可点击、可更换的旋钮，用于音量、媒体和其他控制。包装盒中包含两种尺寸的 M-Dial™：标准版和低位版。

story.x: A haptic driver called Harmonic Synthesiser™ adds subtle physical feedback to typing, dial rotation, and keyboard state changes.
story.z: 一款名为 Harmonic Synthesiser™ 的触觉驱动器为打字、旋钮旋转和键盘状态变化增添了微妙的物理反馈。

story.x: A fully native, Swift-based companion app for macOS gives full control over key mapping, backlight, haptics, audio and M-Dial™ functionality. Its lickable UI feels right at home on Mac.
story.z: 这款完全原生的 macOS 伴侣应用程序基于 Swift 开发，可全面掌控按键映射、背光、触觉、音频和 M-Dial™ 功能。其令人爱不释手的用户界面在 Mac 上使用起来得心应手。

story.x: NiteLite™ is a red backlight that preserves night vision, and reduces eye strain by avoiding the blue light used in most keyboard backlights.
story.z: NiteLite™ 是一种红色背光，可保护夜视能力，并通过避免使用大多数键盘背光中常见的蓝光来减轻眼睛疲劳。

story.x: A two-layer Inertial Damper™ system isolates the typing platform and gives Altar II a unique typing sound and feel.
story.z: 双层 Inertial Damper™ 系统将打字平台隔离开来，为 Altar II 带来独特的打字声音和手感。

story.x: Every element of Altar II — key shape, layout, typography, materials, footprint — is painstakingly designed, down to the last detail.
story.z: Altar II的每个元素——琴键形状、布局、字体、材质、占地面积——都经过精心设计，无一疏漏。

story.x: Altar II's slimline chassis keeps wrists almost flat during typing, reducing the strain associated with most keyboards, and negating the need for angling the typing platform.
story.z: Altar II的纤薄机身使手腕在打字时几乎保持平直，从而减轻了大多数键盘带来的压力，无需将打字平台倾斜。

story.x: Fitting a full mechanical keyboard, battery, haptic system, speaker, and wireless radio into a sub-5mm chassis required bleeding-edge engineering and effort.
story.z: 将全机械键盘、电池、触觉系统、扬声器和无线电收发器装入不到 5 毫米的机身中，需要尖端工程技术和不懈的努力。

story.x: Altar II is made from recycled plastic and recyclable aluminium, and ships in completely plastic-free packaging.
story.z: Altar II 由再生塑料和可回收铝制成，采用完全不含塑料的包装发货。

story.x: Up to 30 days of typical use on a single charge, with two days of usage from two minutes of charging over USB-C.
story.z: 单次充电可提供长达 30 天的典型使用时间，通过 USB-C 充电两分钟即可使用两天。

story.x: Altar II keyboard, coiled USB-C cable, two M-Dials (standard issue and low profile), field manual, and EMO stickers.
story.z: Altar II 键盘、盘绕式 USB-C 线缆、两个 M-Dial（标准版和低位版）、使用手册和 EMO 贴纸。

story.x: Recorded on pre-production hardware with Zoom H5, 24-bit/48kHz, XY stereo, 40cm above device, 80Hz high-pass.
